bullets.text: A Chennai sinkhole opened on Old Mahabalipuram Road trapping an SUV near a Metro site, and the office should monitor traffic congestion.
CUMTA proposed a bus-priority corridor linking Tambaram, Velachery, Pallavaram and Taramani to improve connectivity, and the office should track project progress.
CUMTA planned road improvements from GST Road to Velachery to resolve traffic congestion, and the office should watch implementation.
Chennai announced a mega upgrade on GST Road integrating bus, rail and metro services, and the office should follow developments.
Ambika Jain was appointed as the new commissioner of Avadi Corporation, and the office should note this administration change.
District collector S. Kavitha instructed officials to quickly finish pending atrocity cases, and the office should monitor compliance.
The Water Resources Department stepped up Kandaleru-Poondi canal desilting due to delayed Krishna water supply, and the office should watch water management.
MeitY advised social media platforms to curb manipulated content and deepfakes, and the office should track platform compliance.
Over 4700 government schools faced internet failures after switching to BSNL connections, and the office should assist in restoring connectivity.
Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that AI regulation consultation reports will be released in a month, and the office should review them.
Amid law and order criticisms, the Tamil Nadu government transferred Home Secretary Manivasan and other IAS officers, and the office should monitor developments.
Nainar Nagendran warned that the public will teach a lesson if law and order is not maintained, and the office should watch political reactions.
Critics protested against foreign universities and the National Education Policy in Tamil Nadu, and the office should note the opposition.
